fixture.baseCommitRule: copy the Fixture, run docs sync and unit tests, initialize Git, commit every resulting Fixture file, record the Architecture hash, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm round one reads Architecture, completed SPEC-310 Bundle, implementation, tests, Recall Eval Record and Git facts, then presents the current SHA-256 and a source-backed semantic diff of additions, modifications and retained facts.
Confirm round one is write-free and the exact proposed semantics are applied only after approval bound to the observed Architecture hash, with any hash or proposal drift requiring a new review.

Confirm Architecture describes the implemented lexical-vector score fusion and stable post-filter ordering, cites SPEC-310 and Recall Eval, preserves true process boundaries, and excludes every unimplemented SPEC-311 capability.

Confirm the approved second round changes only hello-scholar/architecture.md and creates no proposal file, report, second Architecture, Spec, Plan, Tasks, Record, Index, runtime or Git-history mutation.

hardRejects: writes Architecture or any other file before the Eval main agent approves the observed Proposal and current Architecture hash
writes an unapproved semantic change or continues after the approved file hash changes
describes Draft SPEC-311 or another unimplemented design as current system reality
changes any Spec, Plan, Tasks, Record, Index, source, test, result, project rule, or Git history
creates an Architecture proposal file, recovery report, second Architecture, Plan, Tasks, or Run
reads the hello-scholar Task Packet, production Skill, or other Eval evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the evidence-bound Architecture proposal request is delivered
a source-backed semantic diff Proposal and current Architecture hash have been presented with zero workspace writes
rounds.message: 批准你刚才提交的 Architecture 语义 diff Proposal，并确认当前 hello-scholar/architecture.md 的 SHA-256 是 f8a8026855e11793a1fede29f57302ebdd59ea4ccc07e14e12ff21f9b6ef3534。只应用该 Proposal 到正式 Architecture；不要修改其他文件，也不要写入 SPEC-311 的草案能力。

criticalPath: Read current Architecture and milestone evidence, then present the current hash and first source-backed semantic change proposal before any write.
